title: A phase4 AS4 receipt handler gives the acceptance decision a record independent of the AS4 exchange
content:
The integration hangs off a phase4 AS4 receipt handler, dispatching a typed RECEIVE plus ACCEPT operation. Two operations rather than one is the modelling decision worth noticing: receiving a document and accepting it are separate events, and collapsing them loses the case where something arrives and is not accepted.

The stated goal is that the acceptance decision has an append-only record independent of the AS4 exchange. Transport-level machinery establishes that a message was delivered; it does not establish that the receiving organisation took it on. Separating the two puts the business decision outside the protocol layer that carried it.

The single lead is Helger IT Consulting GmbH in Vienna, marked "2 · next", with Peppol as its tool. The receive-versus-accept split is the same distinction the ZUGFeRD group draws between format and approval, arriving from the transport side rather than the document side — two independent leads in the e-invoicing space pointing at the same missing layer.
